title: 沿海传感网络运维材料

branches.label: 网络健康报告
branches.query: Report health and performance for a 14-station coastal sensor network. Compare LoRaWAN loss, satellite latency and jitter, fiber utilization, and capacity for expansion to 22 stations.

branches.label: 审查更新运维文档
branches.query: Audit runbooks and architecture documents against current network topology. Capture cellular-to-LoRaWAN migrations, new VLAN segmentation, and storm failover procedures in updated documentation.

branches.label: 提炼可复用经验
branches.query: Record a reusable operational learning pattern from storm alerting. Explain the actual 40% loss paging threshold, the desired 15% threshold, threshold tuning and transferable best practices.
